name: What are the common signs of a hidden pipe leak in my home?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a hidden pipe leak in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a hidden pipe leak include unexplained increases in your water bill, the sound of running water when no fixtures are in use, damp spots on walls, ceilings, or floors, and a musty odor. You might also notice a decrease in water pressure. Detecting these signs early is crucial to prevent more extensive damage. CG Plumbing Solutions uses specialized equipment to precisely locate hidden leaks, minimizing invasive repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Unexplained high water bills, the sound of running water, damp spots, and musty odors are common signs of a hidden pipe leak.
